Business — QCT / Competition）——競争要因に価格が入り、しかも『顧客が複数調達を望むこと』を挙げる＝ロックインの反対　『QCT generally allows customers to reschedule delivery dates within a defined time frame and to cancel orders prior to shipment with or without payment of a cancellation fee, depending on when the order is canceled.』（Item 1. Business — QCT）——購買義務が無く、出荷前の取消が可能　『Certain of our largest mobile handset customers (for example, Apple, Samsung and Xiaomi) develop their own integrated circuit products, which they have in the past utilized, and/or currently utilize, in certain of their devices.』（Item 1A. Risk Factors —『Our business, particularly our semiconductor business, may suffer as a result of our customers vertically integrating』）——顧客の内製・垂直統合＝規約が名指しする反証そのもの　『we expect that Apple will increasingly use its own modem products, rather than our products, in its future devices, which will have a significant negative impact on our QCT revenues, results of operations and cash flows』（Item 1A. Risk Factors／Item 7 MD&A）——売上10%超の顧客が現に離脱中＝移行が現実に起きている　『In addition, certain of our largest customers have in the past utilized, currently utilize and may in the future utilize our competitors’ integrated circuit products in some or all of their devices, rather than our products.』（Item 1A. Risk Factors — 競争）——最大顧客が競合品を併用していると会社が明記　『The semiconductor industry is highly cyclical, volatile, subject to downturns and characterized by constant and rapid technological change, price erosion, evolving technical standards, frequent new product introductions, short product life cycles and fluctuations in product supply and demand.』（Item 1A. Risk Factors — 業界の循環性）——価格浸食と短い製品寿命＝規約が挙げる反証　《反証（同じ原本に同居する）》『The automotive industry is subject to long design-in time frames, long product life cycles and a high degree of regulatory and safety requirements, necessitating suppliers to the industry to comply with stringent qualification processes, very low defect rates and high reliability standards, all of which results in a significant barrier to entry and may result in increased costs.』 ／ 『For example, the automotive industry is subject to long design-in time frames, long product life cycles and a high degree of regulatory and safety requirements, necessitating suppliers to the industry to comply with stringent qualification processes, very low defect rates and high reliability standards, all of which results in significant barriers to entry and increased costs.』　《検問と反証の経緯》検問1: 採用引用は全て原本に逐語存在。検問2 機構の名指し=不可: switch/switching が全文0回、installed base 0件、long-term agreement 0件。design win 2件・design-in 2件しか無く、multi-year 5件は全て当社がファウンドリへ負う購買義務（$15.1十億）で向きが逆。検問3 向き: 唯一の候補である『long design-in time frames…stringent qualification processes』の文は2回とも『results in a significant barrier to entry』『results in significant barriers to entry and increased costs』で終わる＝型(4)新規参入障壁でrepの領分。しかも2回目はItem 1Aの『我々の多角化投資が回収できない/時間がかかる』というリスク要因の中に『For example』として置かれており、費用を負うのは当社＝型(2)。検問4 反証の同居: (a)顧客の垂直統合が独立したリスク見出しになっており、Apple/Samsung/Xiaomi が自社ICを開発、Appleは既に自社モデムへ移行中と明記 (b)『certain of our largest customers have in the past utilized, currently utilize and may in the future utilize our competitors’ integrated circuit products』(c)Competition節の競争要因に『desire by certain customers to use multiple suppliers』——顧客が複数調達を望むことを競争要因に挙げている (d)注文は出荷前に取消可・納期変更可 (e)半導体業界を『price erosion…short product life cycles』と記述。検問5 射程: 機構が立たず該当なし。★70への反証の試み: Apple 9件・Samsung 5件・largest customer 3件・vertical 12件・design win/design-in 全件・multi-year 5件・Competition節全文・QTLライセンス条項を読了。QTLの複数年ライセンスはSEP/FRANDの下のIP契約で顧客の移行障壁ではない。70を積極的に支える文は一つも見つからなかった。evidence_gap: 台帳のirr根拠は空。
